title: JC H2 differentiation: connected rates of change
subject: math

objectives.text: Set up a connected-rates problem from a relating equation
successCriteria: I can write the relation between the two quantities before differentiating
I can state which rate is given and which rate is wanted
assessmentPoints: Setup answers in the opening activity
First lines of the circle and ladder solutions

objectives.text: Solve expanding-circle rate problems via the chain rule in time
successCriteria: I can differentiate A = pi r^2 with respect to time
I can substitute the given radius and rate to find dA/dt
assessmentPoints: Board solution steps in the circle activity

objectives.text: Solve sliding-ladder problems using Pythagoras as the relation
successCriteria: I can use x^2 + y^2 = 25 as the relation for the ladder
I can find dy/dt when dx/dt and the position are given
assessmentPoints: Board solution steps in the ladder activity

objectives.text: Explain why dy/dx is not a fraction that can be cancelled
successCriteria: I can say what the d-notation actually records
I can explain why cancelling the d symbols gives a wrong method
assessmentPoints: Responses when the trap is sprung

activities.title: Connected rates: one quantity drags another

differentiation.support: Provide the chain-rule scaffold: dA/dt = dA/dr x dr/dt.
